=== Overview ===
It is enshrined at the southwestern edge of the Ōse district in southern Minamiizu, northeast of {{ill|Cape Irōzaki|ceb|Irō Zaki|eo|Kabo Irōzaki|fr|Cap Irō|ja|石廊崎|zh|石廊崎|qid=Q11586512}}.

Its founding is unknown, but it is an old shrine treated as a candidate for the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} '''Hotsusa(wa)ke-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (ほつさ(わ)けのみことじんじゃ), and it is also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō|ja|伊豆国神階帳|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Otsusawake no Myōjin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/ouji_title.htm 王子神社] - 玄松子</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140137-01.html 王子神社] - 延喜式神社の調査</ref>.

In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} (Meiji 6), it was listed as a village shrine<ref name="engi"/>.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Hotsusawake-no-Mikoto (ほつさわけのみこと)
